title: D&D 5.5 SRD Conditions
description: A condition is a temporary game state. The effects of condition define how it affects the target.

repeatable.description: Whether the condition stacks. A property of the condition as a whole, so two effect groups can never disagree about it.

levels.description: Present only on conditions that stack in levels. (i.e Exhaustion ). `derivedValueId` names the counter that effects reference as `$derived:<id>`.

effectGroups.description: The effects that make up this condition
